profile.en: She is Maika from a future on the brink of destruction due to the Dimensional Invaders and Brain Flayers. Many Taimanin have fallen, but she has survived in a post-apocalyptic world, living in hiding as a former Taimanin. She is a retired Explosive Flame Big Sister who can fully manipulate top-class flames and is also known as the Taimanin of Explosive Flames, or the Fire God. Her way of speaking has evolved from that of a rough, tomboyish girl to a charming, mature woman.
